applies_to: S+S Regeltechnik RYMASKON 1000 room operating units: Interface variants (RYM 13x1/14x1, no outputs) and Controller variants (RYM 13xxC/14xxC with AO or relay outputs), TH/THC/THV/THCV sensor options.
summary: RYMASKON 1000 units are touch room operating units for temperature, fan, sun protection and lighting. The BACnet object list (vendor ID 1545) covers sensor values (temperature, humidity, CO2, VOC), setpoints, operating mode, fan level, presence, sun-protection and light commands and status, header icons, BMS lock and takeover values for the controller outputs, labels, date/time and many configuration values. Controller-only objects (internal controller outputs, Controller OpMode, BMS output overrides) apply to the RYM 13xxC/14xxC variants.
notes: Object names are printed with their type prefix and instance (e.g. AI:TempS1Int_Value_1); line-break spaces inside names are removed.
Some names carry a different number than their instance as printed (AI 18 AI:SP1_Angle_Value_15, AI 213 AI:RODO_Fan_Level_212, TV 7512 TV:TP48_EventHour_7042); kept as printed.
Configuration values (AV/IV/CSV in the configuration sections) are stored in EEPROM and should only be changed during commissioning.
Several IV objects are bit fields (names ending _bitField); the bit meanings are listed in the source. TV (time value) objects are listed with type Other.
Objects marked 'Controller variants only' do not exist or do nothing on Interface variants.
Access is not printed for the bit-field objects IV 411, 413, 700, 1100, 1102 and 3802; shown as R.

source.title: BACnet PIC - Rymaskon 1000 Interface / Controller BACnet

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC address and baud rate on the unit (default 38400), then write the temperature setpoint, operating mode and fan level and read room temperature, presence and operating state. Use IV 409 / the BV lock objects if occupants must not change values the BMS controls.

minimum_points.name: IV:RCBBMS_409_bitField
minimum_points.why: BMS lock of setpoint, fan and presence keys

integration.enable: Controller variants: IV 1607 Controller OpMode sets how the internal controller drives the outputs (0 Off, 1 cooling, 2 heating, 3 both). The BMS can take over each output with the BMS Contr. objects (AV 1608-1610, 1613; IV 1611, 1612, 1615); -1 returns an output to the internal controller.
setup: BACnet MS/TP master; baud 9600-115200, default 38400; isolated transceiver, no internal bias or termination, 1/8 unit load.
gotchas: Configuration objects are kept in EEPROM; write them only during commissioning.
When the BMS takes over a heating/cooling output, set the display operating mode in IV 404 as well (per the object notes).

points.name: IV:Presence_Function_3800
points.states: 0=(default) If Presence Status is "unoccupied", the touch keys for temperature, fan and light/sun protection are blocked for value chang . Navigation through all menus and waking up from the screen saver are retained. Changing Presence Status to "occupied" and enabling all keys for value chang is carried out by presence touch key, by bus or by configured DI input.; 1=If Presence Status is "unoccupied", all buttons remain active (value change and navigation through the menus). Pressing any touch key changes the status to "occupied".; 2=If Presence Status is "unoccupied", the touch keys for temperature, fan and light/sunshade as well as the sensor touch key remain full active (changing values and navigating through the menus). The Presence Status remains "unoccupied" until the presence button, bus or a configured DI input changes to "occupied".
